slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Tech Hive Advisory's update for January and February 2026 says Eswatini's data protection authority published guidelines on data mapping and issued a directive requiring controllers and processors to map their data by 31 March 2026; the update is dated 23 June 2026 and the event falls in early 2026.
